# Role pitch ranges

Pitches are MIDI numbers, 60 = middle C. Onsets are slots 0 to 15 of a sixteenth grid, so slot 4 is beat 2; lengths are in beats. Tiers: M1 is needed in a first test set, M2 has one or two sources or is a jazz or world idiom, M3 is single-source, inferred or theory only. Tags: `source states`, `measured`, `derived` (our computation on public data), `inferred` (our reading), `snippet` (a search excerpt), `single source`, `proposal` (a policy, not a fact). Source ids are listed in `dictionary/sources.json`.

## Role ranges

| sub bass | `role.sub-bass` | core 26 to 35, hard 24 to 40, mono | The sub band below about 60 Hz, played one note at a time. Many playback systems roll off below about 30 Hz, between notes 22 and 23, so the core stays at 26 to 35. | M1 | source states | guides, lexicon |
| 808 | `role.808` | core 24 to 36, hard 23 to 40, mono | A tuned bass drum played one note at a time. Trap roots sit at 28 to 33 and drill roots at 29 to 33, and a root under 23 moves up an octave. | M1 | source states | guides, lexicon |
| bass (mid bass, synth bass, reese, rolling bass) | `role.bass` | core 28 to 48, hard 24 to 60, mono | Mid, synth, reese and rolling bass, played one note at a time. The count is not re-run here. | M1 | single source | lmd, lexicon |

The count is not re-run here. | M1 | single source | lmd, lexicon |

The hard limits cover the whole model range, so only the core can fail. | M1 | single source | lmd, lexicon |
